known_abi_divergences_and_historical_bug.construct: i128 / u128 on x86_64-pc-windows-msvc and x86_64-pc-windows-gnu
known_abi_divergences_and_historical_bug.status_in_1_99_1: Aligned with Clang 19 (`i128` indirect byref pointer in RCX, returned in XMM0 on MSVC? Wait: let's inspect exact IR in tier1_ir_signatures_by_target!)
known_abi_divergences_and_historical_bug.details: Prior to Rust 1.78 / LLVM 18, LLVM passed i128 in integer registers or stack differently from MSVC __m128; in Rust 1.99.1 (LLVM 23.1.1), x86_64-pc-windows-msvc passes and returns i128 indirectly or via XMM0 matching Clang.

known_abi_divergences_and_historical_bug.construct: f16 and f128 on i686-pc-windows-msvc and x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
known_abi_divergences_and_historical_bug.details: MSVC cl.exe lacks native _Float16 and __float128 types; rustc 1.99.1 lowers f16 as half and f128 as fp128 in LLVM IR, which on x86_64-pc-windows-msvc passes fp128 indirectly by pointer (`ptr sret(fp128)`) whereas SysV x86_64 passes fp128 in XMM0.

known_abi_divergences_and_historical_bug.construct: Zero-Sized Types (ZST) in extern "C" parameters and struct fields
known_abi_divergences_and_historical_bug.status_in_1_99_1: Rust ignores ZST fields (`WithZst` -> `{ i32, i32 }` passed packed in single i64 register on SysV x86_64 and AAPCS64), whereas C23/GNU C empty structs `struct {}` have size 0 in GCC/Clang C extension but size 1 in standard C++!

Cranelift supports defining/calling C-variadic functions on x86_64 SysV and AArch64 Linux, but does not support 32-bit i686 targets (`i686-unknown-linux-gnu`, `i686-pc-windows-msvc`) or Windows SEH unwinding.

known_abi_divergences_and_historical_bug.construct: #[repr(C, packed)] structs crossing eightbyte boundaries (e.g. PackedCross8: u8 + u64 + u8 = 10 bytes)
known_abi_divergences_and_historical_bug.status_in_1_99_1: Classified as MEMORY class on SysV x86_64 because the unaligned u64 field crosses the 8-byte eightbyte boundary (`byval(%PackedCross8)` on stack in SysV x86_64, vs `[2 x i64]` in registers on AAPCS64!). Verified identical across rustc_llvm, rustc_cranelift, clang-19, and gcc-14.
